# 3d-winding-road

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. A dark asphalt road ribbon with pale kerbs snaking across the canvas, numbered location pins at each bend. Backdrop: White. Items: 4 to 8. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Road asphalt #2E3238, centre line white, kerb #D9DDE2, pins family blue #1F8BD6 or one brand colour, text charcoal
- Pins may step through the family cycle when items are categories rather than a sequence
- White studio backdrop, faint shadow under the road

## Visual elements

- Road drawn in perspective: wide near the bottom right, narrower toward the top left
- Kerb on the outer edge only, 15 to 25 percent of the road width
- Pins 10 to 14 percent of the canvas height, glossy top highlight, numeral centred
- Dashed centre line continuous through every bend

## Typography

- Family typography; pin numerals bold white, item names bold caps, descriptions light charcoal

## Composition rules

- Landscape: road enters from the right, three bends, exits top left (ref 01)
- Portrait: road enters bottom, snakes upward, four bends
- Four to eight items; fewer than four, use 3d-disc-timeline; more, split into two images

## Layout

### Structure

- One continuous road from the right edge to the top left, three to four S bends, tapering toward the far end for perspective
- One numbered location pin per item planted on the road at a bend or straight, order following the road from the near end
- Labels and descriptions beside each pin, alternating above and below the road
- Road never crosses itself; pins never overlap
- Optional destination marker at the far end

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Road with pins** | Journeys, roadmaps, phases in order | Plain road, glossy map pins with numerals |
| **Road with stops** | Milestones with dates | Small discs on the road edge with date tabs |

### Visual Elements

- Road: dark charcoal asphalt, thin dashed white centre line, thick pale grey kerb on the outer edge for depth
- Pins: glossy teardrop map pins in one family colour, white numeral, small shadow on the road
- Road thickness 6 to 9 percent of the canvas height, soft shadow under the kerb
- No cars, buildings or scenery

### Text Placement

- Title at top right or top left, clear of the road
- Numeral in each pin
- Item name bold caps beside the pin, description light charcoal below it
- Alternate text above and below the road so nothing crosses it
